The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to competent authority to calculate accrued interest on the compensation amount till date and invest the said amount in fixed deposit,
so that when the issue relating to title is decided between the parties, the actual claimant gets interest on the compensation amount.

2. The aforesaid prayer has been rejected by Special Land Acquisition Officer (Joint Organization),
Saharanpur by impugned order observing that there is no such provision under the Right to Yogesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31160275/
1 Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and the National Highways Act, 1956.
